title: Healthy Heavenly Filipino Semolina Halo Halo
description: A light and refreshing Filipino dessert featuring semolina, cooked in a tagine style and served in a terracotta dish, perfect for warm weather and diabetic friendly diets. This dish is a unique twist on the traditional halo halo, with a bitter and springy texture from the semolina.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the semolina and 2 cups of water, whisking constantly to prevent lumps.
Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until the semolina is cooked and has a creamy consistency.
Add the coconut milk, pandan extract, and sugar substitute to the saucepan, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
In a small bowl, mix together the jackfruit, kaong, and ube halaya.
To assemble the halo halo, place a scoop of the semolina mixture into a terracotta dish.
Top the semolina with a spoonful of the jackfruit mixture, followed by a scoop of shaved ice.
Sprinkle the sesame seeds and salt over the top of the halo halo.
Repeat the assembly process for the remaining ingredients.
Garnish with additional sesame seeds and a sprinkle of salt, if desired.
